text:
ana: quick heads-up — started a smoke run for act-norm + SmoothQuant style rescale on the new 13B-long model (128k) to see long-ctx accuracy vs int8/FP8.
ana: baseline is fp16, seq=128k, kv-prefetch on. running: AWQ-like per-channel + act-aware rescale (decay-based) + bias-correction after linear folds.
ryan: nice. what datasets? short/long split?
ana: LAMBADA (short), PIQA (multi-turn), and a custom long-cloze set harvested from docs (32k/64k/128k splits). also running perplexity on the perf set.
mike: can you paste the exact command you used so I can reproduce locally?
ana: sure
ana: ```bash
./run_quant_bakeoff.sh \
  --model redwood-13b-long-v1 \
  --quant awq_actnorm \
  --seq_len 131072 \
  --kv_cache_prefetch true \
  --bias_correction true \
  --fp8_mode e4m3
```
jen: are you doing per-layer actnorm or global? we saw layerwise gives fewer regressions earlier.
ana: layerwise, but only on odd transformer blocks (1,3,5..) as an experiment to avoid over-scaling attention keys. trying a variant with full layerwise for comparison.
ci-bot: CI job queued: bakeoff/1812345678-ACTNORM-SQ queued by ana. Estimated runtime: 2h 40m.
ana: first quick snapshot (32k split) — fp16 perplexity 10.2, FP8(e4m3) naive quant 11.0 (+7.8%), AWQ-actnorm 10.4 (+1.96%).
ryan: that looks promising for FP8 + actnorm. what's the exact failure mode on long runs?
mike: on 64k/128k we saw KV cache dropoff — attention keys decay causing context bleed, leading to odd token repeats at ~window boundary.
ana: yup. observed repeating phrases around position ~62k in 64k runs. added a kludge: clamp per-channel scale to [0.7,1.1] for attention key projections, which reduced repeats but increased small PPL.
jen: can you share a short log snippet of the repeat? curious about token patterns.
ana: ```
[2026-03-19 14:02:11] INFO generation: prompt len 64000
[2026-03-19 14:02:18] WARN generation: repeated token window detected at pos 62312..62380 pattern="the the the"
[2026-03-19 14:02:18] DEBUG quant: layer 22 K_proj scale=1.84 clamped->1.1
```
ryan: interesting. might be related to activation distribution shift for K/V when we quantize keys aggressively. have we tried mixing int8 for FFN and FP8 for attention?
ana: yes, hybrid config: attn FP8(e4m3) + ffn INT8 gave best perplexity/throughput tradeoff so far: PPL 10.3 (32k), 10.9 (64k), memory ~32% down vs fp16.
mike: throughput numbers?
ana: with batch=1 streaming tokens: fp16 ~580 tok/s, hybrid ~720 tok/s, full int8 ~940 tok/s but with worst regressions at 128k.
jen: thanks. next steps from infra side: if bakeoff stable, we should canary to dedicated pool with kv-prefetch=false to reproduce production environment.
ana: agreed. also want to test a variant that applies simple per-layer bias-correction after GPTQ folding step — a tiny affine bias fix improved LAMBADA exact-match by +0.6% in dev.
ryan: can you add that to the script and re-run the top failing seeds, and also capture token-level diffs for the failing examples? helps root cause.
ana: will run now on 3 seeds (rng seeds 42/99/123) and dump diffs to s3: s3://redwood-ml/tmp/actnorm_bakeoff/1812345678/
mike: if stable, we should create an eval-alert: register the metric delta (LAMBADA EM) and a regression threshold (0.5%) before rollout.
ana: +1. planning to attach a small regression harness and add to Redwood Console evals so we can graph changes per deploy.
ci-bot: bakeoff/1812345678 started. logs streaming -> https://logs.internal/redwood/bakeoffs/1812345678
jen: FYI ops: watch out for OOMs on the 2nd checkpoint with kv-prefetch true; last time a prefetcher memory leak popped at 96k.
a na: oops typo — "ana:" meant. noted.
ryan: thanks everyone. please ping here when the three-seed run finishes. if numbers hold, we'll open a PR to add the hybrid actnorm+awq profile to the model catalog as a beta variant.
mike: can you also run a small offline eval for hallucination score on instructions > 8k? earlier quant setups increased factual hallucination in longInstr tasks.
ana: adding hallucination eval (QA-Foldset) to the batch. will report back in ~3h.
deploy-bot: canary request created for model redwood-13b-long-v1@quant-actnorm-hybrid -> dedicated-pool-small. waiting approvals.
ana: thanks, will follow up with a brief summary and the s3 link when done. :thumbsup:
